messages:
parul: FYI - customer Vantara asked how the new ratecard v3.1 affects POC credit stacking. They want a single rollover commit if they sign within 45 days. Any blockers?
drew: Ratecard v3.1 changes the naming of SKU lines and adds model-level multipliers. That means SOWs must reference exact SKU IDs or the conversion math will be off.
mohit: Deal Desk: we can support rollover commits but need explicit mapping in SOW to the new SKU ids. Also need to lock the ratecard version in the SOW (e.g., RATECARD=v3.1) to avoid surprises on conversion.
amy: Ops: prefer metered+credited for POCs. If they want a 45d conversion window we can do it, but credits should expire after 45d and not be transferable across billing entities.
parul: Customer wants credits to be applied to any future enterprise commit under the same parent org. How strict are we on billing entity vs parent org?
mohit: We require a BILLING_ENTITY value. "Parent org" wording is too fuzzy. If they want cross-account transfers, Deal Desk needs to add a transfer rule in the SOW and RevOps will require CSV mapping.
revops-bot: RevOps CSV schema reminder: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,CREDIT_CAP,RATECARD_VERSION,CONSOLIDATE_TO_COMMIT_ID. Attach with /deal-request.
drew: Also call out shared infra caveat: if multiple POCs reuse the same project the KV cache will reduce observed token cost vs isolated estimates. Add a disclosure line.
parul: Draft SOW snippet (please review):
```
RATECARD=v3.1
BILLING_ENTITY=Vantara-NA
POC_TAGS=VTR-POC-A,VTR-POC-B
POC_WINDOW=2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31
POC_CREDIT=100% metered usage credited up to $25,000 per POC
CONVERSION_WINDOW=45d
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=45d
STACKING_LIMIT=2 active POCs per BILLING_ENTITY without Deal Desk approval
RATE_SKU_REFERENCE=redwood.gen.gn-xl:v3.1;redwood.quant.small:v3.1
DISCLOSURE=Shared infra or endpoint reuse may affect combined cost estimates
```
mohit: That looks good. I'll prep the /deal-request and route to Legal. Add a sentence that RevOps will validate usage logs before applying credits.
legal-bot: Legal note: lock RATECARD version in SOW. Credits timeboxed and auditable; no cash refunds for committed fees; include audit rights and validation requirements before credit application.
amy: Once Legal signs, RevOps will import CSV and flag the commit record with RATECARD=v3.1. Parul, please attach model usage projections in the deal-request.
parul: Will attach CSV and traffic profiles today. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
